info.brief: Functions for interacting with the SplitMix64 native extension
info.description: Functions for interacting with the SplitMix64 native extension

elements.name: splitmix64.random
elements.description: When called without arguments, returns a uniform pseudo-random real number in the range [0,1). When called with an integer number m, splitmix64.random returns a uniform pseudo-random integer in the range [1, m]. When called with two integer numbers m and n, splitmix64.random returns a uniform pseudo-random integer in the range [m, n].

elements.name: splitmix64.randomseed
elements.description: Sets x as the "seed" for the pseudo-random generator: equal seeds produce equal sequences of numbers. Accepts a number or a string (decimal representation of uint64) for full 64-bit precision.

parameters.name: x
parameters.doc: Seed value as number or string (e.g. \"18446744073709551615\" for full uint64 range).

elements.name: splitmix64.state
elements.description: Returns the current internal state x as a string. Use this to save/restore state or pass to randomseed for full 64-bit precision (Lua double cannot represent all uint64 values).

elements.name: splitmix64.randomchoice
elements.description: Returns a random value from array t. If the array is empty an error is raised.

parameters.name: t
parameters.doc: Array of values to choose from.

elements.name: splitmix64.weightedchoice
elements.description: Takes table t where keys are choices and values are weights. Returns a random key. Keys are sorted deterministically (numbers first, then strings lexicographically) before selection, so the result is reproducible for the same seed. Weights must be >= 0. If all weights are 0 or a weight is negative, an error is raised.

elements.name: splitmix64.new_instance
elements.description: Creates a new RNG instance with independent state. Optional seed (number or string) for reproducibility.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.doc: Optional seed for the new instance.

returnvalues.name: rng
returnvalues.doc: RNG instance with methods random, randomseed, state, randomchoice, weightedchoice, toss, dice, shuffle. Same API as the module but with isolated state.

elements.name: splitmix64.dice
elements.description: Roll one or more dice of the given type. Returns a table of individual rolls and the total sum.

parameters.name: roll
parameters.doc: Number of dice to roll (must be > 0).

parameters.name: type
parameters.doc: Dice type (splitmix64.D4, splitmix64.D6, splitmix64.D8, splitmix64.D10, splitmix64.D12, splitmix64.D20, or splitmix64.D100).

elements.name: splitmix64.shuffle
elements.description: Shuffles an array using the Fisher-Yates algorithm. Returns a shuffled copy of the array, or if inplace is true, shuffles the original array in-place and returns it.

parameters.name: inplace
parameters.doc: If true, shuffle the array in-place instead of creating a copy. Defaults to false.

returnvalues.name: result
returnvalues.doc: The shuffled array (a new table, or the same table if inplace is true).

elements.name: splitmix64.D100
elements.brief: Dice type constant for percentile die (0, 10, 20, ..., 90).
